info.name: NexHealth Adjustment Types Clinical Notes API

params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: location_id
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified location

params.name: patient_id
params.description: Filter by the id of the associated patient

params.name: procedure_id
params.description: Filter by procedure, only return clinical notes that are associated with the procedure ID. This association only exists in certain EHRs and for certain types of notes

params.name: entered_before
params.description: Only return clinical notes that were created on or before the provided datetime

params.name: entered_after
params.description: Only return clinical notes that were created on or after the provided datetime

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Only return clinical notes updated after the specified time (UTC)

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the clinical notes for the specified location. At least one of the patient_id, procedure_id, entered_before, entered_after, or updated_since filters must be provided. Results are cursor-paginated.
